content:
emily_chen: Heads up team — AeroSense onboarding lab tomorrow at 09:00 PDT. Host change: Raj can't make it, can someone swap in as lead? :wave:
rajiv: Sorry, got pulled into an exec briefing. Can @lena_g or @tom_s cover the walkthrough? I can do the Q&A portion if needed at 10:00 PT.
lena_g: I can take the walkthrough (09:00-09:45). Need the updated agenda and the runbook link plz.
tom_s: I can do 09:00 but prefer to handle demo env. Who's presenting the dedicated migration slide?
emily_chen: I'll present the migration slides. @lena_g you'll demo the integration flow and I'll jump to rollout and renewal risks at the end.
mara_cs: Quick note: AeroSense is flagged medium renewal risk (usage lagging). Keep the "value metric" section front-loaded.
emily_chen: @mara_cs good call — we'll emphasize cost savings and latency before Q&A.
lena_g: Need the creds for their staging cluster. @ops-bot can you confirm access was provisioned?
ops-bot: staging access for AeroSense provisioned to lena_g, tom_s, emily_chen at 2024-11-02T14:12Z — link: https://redwood.app/staging/aerosense
tom_s: Got it. Can we add a 5-min "how to read cost breakdowns" demo? That helps renewals.
emily_chen: Yes — agenda updated:
```
- 09:00 - 09:05: Welcome + intro (emily_chen)
- 09:05 - 09:25: Integration demo (lena_g)
- 09:25 - 09:35: Cost & latency breakdowns (tom_s)
- 09:35 - 09:45: Migration plan + reuse patterns (emily_chen)
- 09:45 - 10:00: Q&A + next steps (all)
```
lena_g: I'll capture feedback in the shared doc; link?
emily_chen: feedback doc: https://docs.redwood.com/aerosense-onboard-feedback
mara_cs: Can we add a short post-session NPS pulse 1 hour after? I can send out the form.
emily_chen: Yes please. Also tagging renewals: @kelly_re up for a quick pre-call chase for exec presence?
kelly_re: I can join 5-10 mins at the start. Will ping AeroSense VP now.
rajiv: I'll join for final Q&A remotely at 09:50 PT.
emily_chen: Thanks everyone. Action items: lena_g get staging creds confirmed, tom_s prepare cost demo snippet, mara_cs schedule NPS pulse, kelly_re chase exec. I'll update calendar and post final agenda.
tom_s: One more thing — remind them to disable the older inference pipeline before demo (our staging mirrors prod).
emily_chen: Added note to runbook. See you all tomorrow. :rocket:
